responsibility: Implements GCC’s GIMPLE value-profiling framework and the profile-guided transformations that consume its histograms. This file scans statements to decide which runtime values to instrument—such as divisors, indirect-call targets, string operation sizes and alignments, and time-profile sites—attaches and manages histogram_value records on statements, computes per-histogram counter requirements, and performs profile-use transformations like division/modulo specialization, indirect-call promotion support, and string-operation optimization based on the collected histograms. It is the main execution layer behind the value-prof.h interface used by profile instrumentation and profile-use passes.
same_name_distinction: This source file is the implementation of the value-profiling framework declared in gcc/value-prof.h. It decides which GIMPLE statements get histograms, manages histogram attachment/storage, computes counter requirements, and performs profile-use transformations such as division/modulo, indirect-call, and string-operation specialization; the header only defines histogram types/data structures and declares the APIs.
